localChanges: Choosing Revolution now asks you to confirm, then puts your civilization into Anarchy for one to four turns, as in Civ1. When it's over, you choose your new government before you can end the turn (closes #33).
The panel on the left now shows your government, and during Anarchy how many turns are left.
If you own the Pyramids, a revolution skips Anarchy, and you can choose any government, even one whose advance you don't have yet. This stops once anyone discovers Communism (part of #30).
Computer players go through Anarchy too when they change government.
